note: RC17 is RC11 with the C++17 release-sequence narrowing (RMWs only). Like the C11→C++17 case the narrowing is monotone — it only removes synchronisation — so RC17 admits an outcome RC11 forbids and forbids nothing RC11 allows. Mechanised: mp-rs-add-est-atomic is Never under rc11.cat and Sometimes under rc17.cat. Models vendored from gonzalobg/cpp_memory_model; see litmus/strictly-weaker/RC11-vs-RC17.
